name: Latham's Almshouses

layers.essential_history: [[c:Parson Nicholas Latham founded almshouses here in 1601 for the poor of the village. They were rebuilt in 1874.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Latham also founded a hospital in Oundle. He died in 1620 and has a monument in St Andrew's church.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Bess the housekeeper says Master Thorne the lawyer asked her three times where the parson kept his keys.]]

evidence: [[c:Master Thorne kept asking where the parson kept his keys.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north, about 70 metres as the crow flies, to the war memorial.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
